defects_visible_in_light_mode.name: inbox__graphblank empty-state scrim

defects_visible_in_light_mode.name: system-bar__readout tint
defects_visible_in_light_mode.issue: Hardcoded black tint renders as darker gray strip inside the light topbar (ENGINE/MODEL/CONTEXT readout). Clearly visible in light-topbar.png — the central strip is grayer than the surrounding system bar.

defects_visible_in_light_mode.name: onboarding__aside tint
defects_visible_in_light_mode.issue: Hardcoded black tint on the right-side archetype panel in the onboarding wizard. Subtle but visible — right side of the wizard card is darker than the left.

defects_visible_in_light_mode.name: graph/agents/sessions empty-state scrims (conditional)

defects_visible_in_light_mode.name: system-bar__scrim (conditional)

evidence.verified_first_data_theme_after_navigate: light (with persisted theme=light, even with OS=dark)

css_variable_adoption.comment_on_change: Major progress on the surface adoption — all 14 feature CSS files now use var(--pa-*) extensively. However, a small set of dark-scrim/overlay literals (rgba(14,14,14,X) and rgba(0,0,0,X) on background or background-image) were missed. These create visible defects in light mode.

verdict.bar: PARTIAL PASS — round 1's primary failure (light theme broken for shell/composer/views) is FIXED, but a small set of dark-scrim overlays remain and create visible defects in light mode (most visibly on Inbox empty state and SystemBar readout strip).

round_1_to_round_2_summary.round1_d1_light_broken: FIXED — body, sidebar, topbar, composer, cards, graph canvas all switch to light.
round_1_to_round_2_summary.round1_d2_white_text_on_light: FIXED — only 1 element with light text in light mode (Stop button, intentional).
round_1_to_round_2_summary.round1_d3_no_var_adoption: FIXED — all 14 feature CSS files now use var(--pa-*); 576 hex → 9 dark-scrim literals.
round_1_to_round_2_summary.round1_d4_light_bg_inside_dark_shell: FIXED — shell is now light in light mode.
round_1_to_round_2_summary.new_defect_d5_dark_scrims_in_light_mode: PARTIAL — hardcoded rgba(14,14,14,X) and rgba(0,0,0,X) literals on background (not shadows, not modal backdrops) create dark patches on light surfaces. 6 affected selectors across 5 files.

verdict_message: Light theme works for ~95% of the surface. The remaining 5% is scrim/overlay backgrounds that the conversion script treated as 'dark backdrop' and left alone. Most visible defect is the Inbox empty-state scrim (a large gray rectangle sits where the empty-state copy should be on a light canvas). Second-most visible is the SystemBar readout strip (the ENGINE/MODEL/CONTEXT strip is grayer than the surrounding topbar). Round-1 critical failure (entire shell staying dark in light mode) is genuinely fixed — but the bar's 'NO dark backgrounds in light mode' clause is not fully met.
